name: 67039 · Douglass, KS
findings: ZIP 67039 (Douglass) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (70%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67039 (Douglass) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 67039 (Douglass) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
